meta.scope: EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md claims (sections 2-6, incl. the automation paragraph) and the committed snapshot files data/latest/top_events.json, data/latest/resolutions.json, data/latest/markets_settled.json, data/meta.json, data/latest/portfolio.json, data/cors_test.json
meta.method: Official Kalshi docs (docs.kalshi.com) read in full on the checked date; live Kalshi demo API responses read via the fetch tool (URLs listed per row); committed repo files read directly and cited by path. A row is 'Verified' only when an official source or live response confirms the exact claim. Anything that could not be confirmed is marked 'Not reproduced' and left unverified; no value was inferred or filled in.

results_legend.Verified: Confirmed by an official doc page or a live official API response (exact claim).
results_legend.Partly verified: Some of the claim is confirmed; the rest is unconfirmed or needs qualification.
results_legend.Contradicted: Current official data or committed repo data shows the claim is wrong or stale.
results_legend.Flagged: Not a factual error by itself, but an irregularity or decision needed for review.
results_legend.Not reproduced: Could not be checked from this environment; left unverified and not used.

sections.title: A. Official API facts (docs and live responses)

rows.claim: Demo REST Trade API root is https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 (recommended demo endpoint).
rows.note: Docs list this host as the recommended demo REST root; the live call returned series data.

rows.claim: Demo WebSocket endpoint is wss://external-api-ws.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/ws/v2.
rows.note: Confirmed in the docs. No WebSocket connection was opened from this environment.

rows.claim: Public market data can be read without an API key on demo.

official.label: Quick start: market data, 'No authentication headers are required' (docs)

rows.note: The docs quick start uses production hosts; the demo behaviour was confirmed by the live call only.

rows.claim: WebSocket connections require authentication during the handshake, including for public channels.
rows.note: Docs state the handshake needs KALSHI-ACCESS-* headers. This is why the browser pages poll REST.

rows.claim: Candlesticks use /series/{series_ticker}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks with period_interval 1, 60 or 1440 minutes.
rows.note: Docs list the series-scoped path and the three intervals; the live call returned OHLC candles with volume and open interest.

rows.claim: The older path /markets/{ticker}/candlesticks fails on demo (404).

evidence.label: Old path request (fetch tool returned a generic error, no HTTP status)

rows.note: The docs document only the series-scoped path. The fetch tool hides the HTTP status, so the 404 claim is left unverified in this session.

rows.claim: Settlement pays $1 per contract to holders of the winning side (Yes or No).
rows.note: Docs: 'Yes outcome: Yes contract holders receive $1 per contract'. Settlement fees may apply to sub-cent scalar markets only.

rows.claim: Settled demo markets expose result (yes/no), status 'finalized' and settlement_ts.

official.label: Get Markets: result, status, settlement_ts fields (docs)

evidence.label: Live settled market KXAAAGASM-26OCT31-4.18: result yes, status finalized, settlement_ts 2026-10-31T14:10:30.416365Z

rows.note: Exact values confirmed in the live response.

rows.claim: Open markets return status 'active', while the status filter uses 'open' (naming mismatch).

official.label: Get Markets: status filter values unopened, open, closed, settled (docs)

rows.note: The filter values in the docs and the response values differ, as the summary says. Clients must map them.

rows.claim: The market object has no dollar-volume field; volume is reported in contracts (volume_fp).

evidence.label: Live market record showing volume_fp, open_interest_fp, notional_value_dollars and no dollar-volume field

rows.note: Any dollar figure is a derived estimate. See AU-20.

rows.claim: Demo prices and behaviour may not reflect real markets.
rows.note: Docs: 'The price and behavior of markets in the demo environment may not be reflective of those in real markets.'

rows.claim: Dollar volume is approximately the sum of contracts x price.

official.label: Get Markets: volume_fp (contracts) and notional_value_dollars fields (docs)

evidence.label: Collector formula: volume_dollars_derived = volume_fp x notional_value_dollars (scripts/collect_kalshi_data.py, line 221)

rows.note: The code does not multiply by price. On the sampled demo markets notional is 1.0000, so the 'dollar' figure equals the contract count. It is not dollars traded.

rows.claim: notional_value_dollars is '1.0000' on every contract (checked live).

sections.title: C. Repository data irregularities (flagged for review)

evidence.label: Event listed under gas in data/latest/top_events.json

rows.note: Misclassification. The title and rules are about a La Liga match, not gas prices. Fix the regex and re-run the classification.

rows.claim: The 'gas' topic includes energy, oil and EV markets: WTI crude, ERCOT grid load, primary energy consumption, EV market share.

evidence.label: Tag rule maps any 'energy' or 'oil & gas' tag to gas (scripts/collect_kalshi_data.py, lines 79-84)

rows.note: Not gasoline-price markets. Owner decision: keep these as 'energy' or drop them from the gas topic. The brief asks for gas prices.

rows.claim: The gas resolution tracker holds 300 resolved 'gas' markets.

official.label: Live record of a 'gas'-topic row, KXQUICKSETTLE-20NOV26H0640-2 (official API)

evidence.label: Committed snapshot: 250 of 300 gas rows are KXQUICKSETTLE; 30 KXWTI; 20 KXBRENTD

rows.note: Most 'gas' rows are synthetic exchange-test markets titled '1+1 = 2' (live: rules 'If 1+1 equals 2 ... resolves to Yes'). The rest are crude-oil markets. No gasoline-price market is in this topic. Matches FLAGGED I-15.

official.label: Get Markets fields used by both formulas (docs)
